description: The research pipeline shall validate each source record for provenance and license or consent evidence before training eligibility.
limitation: Public-provider license evidence is retained; original individual consent is not independently audited.

description: The research pipeline shall reject a manifest containing a related-source group in more than one partition.
limitation: Rejects folder-group/raw-hash/decoded-hash overlap. Broader related-source identity is not established.

description: The research pipeline shall record each augmentation recipe and apply the configured recipe distribution to both genuine and synthetic classes.
limitation: Same label-independent recipe distribution; deterministic seeds and source IDs.

description: The research pipeline shall train an MFCC-statistics SVM reference using the frozen training/development split.
limitation: MFCC statistics, training-only scaling and development-only hyperparameter choice.

description: The research pipeline shall train a compact CNN with ordinary training and a matched variant using varied noise and compression.
limitation: Six from-scratch runs, ordinary/augmented matched architecture and budgets.

description: The research pipeline shall train a causal TCN comparator using the same split and declared feature protocol.
limitation: Optional TCN not trained.

description: The research pipeline shall select operating thresholds using development data only and persist them before final testing.
limitation: Thresholds and model selection frozen from development before final evaluation.

description: The research pipeline shall export class recalls, balanced accuracy, EER, FPR, sample counts and confusion matrices for every mandatory test condition.
limitation: All mandatory clean/noise/codec conditions and per-class metrics retained.

description: The research pipeline shall label held-out-generator and code-switched evaluations separately from the main test results when those datasets are available.
limitation: Directional public-family transfer tests only; code-switching and independent new cloning generators not evaluated.

description: The evaluation tools shall export model bytes, reference-device details and preprocessing-plus-inference latency observations.

description: The packaging tools shall produce an ONNX model with preprocessing, class-label, threshold, aggregation, version and checksum metadata.

description: The packaging tools shall evaluate an INT8 variant against its full-precision export when the runtime supports the required operators.
